scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=backend
scripts.test:web: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=web
